title: Auditing Apparent Quantum Feature-Circuit Gains on Synthetic Compositional Language Tasks: QNLPBench-R Stage 8A Reproducibility Release
description: QNLPBench-R is an audit-first synthetic benchmark and reproducibility release for evaluating apparent quantum feature-circuit representation gains. The Stage 8A evidence supports a controlled negative result against validation-selected learned classical representation kernels and a narrower within-family trainability diagnostic. The release contains the public source, frozen inputs and outputs, exact checkpoints, manifests, tests, verification records, and final independent Linux replay evidence. It does not include the unpublished manuscript.
